releases.name: opencode-model-tiers@0.1.10
releases.body:
## 0.1.10

- Pin newly initialized plugin entries to the current package version.
- Restore interactive migration prompts for existing JSON and Markdown agent
  model assignments during initialization.
- Add `init --local` for testing the workspace plugin without loading a cached
  npm package.
- Resolve nested tier references while preserving inherited model variants.
- Add cyclic and nested tier resolution safeguards during plugin startup.
